mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.level, s.department_id, s.state AS staff_state, u.email, u.password_hash, u.salt, u.sign_up_time, u.last_login_time, s.remember_token, s.remember_token_expires, s.csrf_userid, s.csrf_token, d.name AS dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS ticket_assigned_count FROM staff s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = s.department_id LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.assignee_id = s.id AND t.closed = 0 WHERE u.email = #{email} GROUP BY s.id

SELECT s.id, s.level, s.department_id, s.state AS staff_state, u.email, u.password_hash, u.salt, u.sign_up_time, u.last_login_time, s.remember_token, s.remember_token_expires, s.csrf_userid, s.csrf_token, d.name AS dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.assignee_id = s.id AND t.closed = 0) AS ticket_assigned_count FROM staff s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = s.department_id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.id, s.level, s.department_id, s.state AS staff_state, u.email, u.sign_up_time, d.name AS dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.assignee_id = s.id AND t.closed = 0) AS ticket_assigned_count FROM staff s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = s.department_id WHERE s.id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO staff (id, level, department_id, state, sign_up_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{level}, #{departmentId}, #{state}, datetime('now'))
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, salt = #{salt}, last_login_time = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE staff SET department_id = #{deptId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE staff SET state = #{state} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.level, s.department_id, s.state AS staff_state, u.email, u.sign_up_time, d.name AS dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.assignee_id = s.id AND t.closed = 0) AS ticket_assigned_count FROM staff s JOIN users u ON u.id = s.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = s.department_id ORDER BY u.sign_up_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE tickets SET assignee_id = NULL WHERE assignee_id = #{staffId}
UPDATE tickets SET closed = 1, status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE assignee_id = #{staffId}
